response.justification: Bogdan brings 14+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile and embedded, a CS degree, and genuine depth in developer tooling, testing culture and open-source library authorship — all of which map to the 'build systems that make other teams faster' and mentorship aspects of the role. However, the resume shows no experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, telemetry, or metrics-platform experience, which is the substantive core of this position, and there is little evidence of high data aptitude or statistical analysis. Scale and scope also fall short of Principal/IC6 expectations: aside from the Sociomantic/dunnhumby low-latency ad-tech work, most roles are small-to-mid product teams rather than multi-region, globally distributed services with cross-org influence. Worth a screening conversation if the pipeline is thin and the hiring manager values strong fundamentals over domain experience, but he would be a stretch hire against the stated bar.
strengths: 14+ years of production experience with breadth across languages (TypeScript, C/C++, Java, C#, D) and a CS degree
Real high-throughput, low-latency systems work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby (millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Demonstrated systemic/tooling mindset: open-source test runner, assertion library, MCP code generators, CI/CD and TDD advocacy, plus teaching and conference talks
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flighting or rollout-risk experience — the central requirement
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or data-driven growth measurement
Scope and title trajectory (Senior/Staff on small teams) below Principal/IC6 bar for multi-workstream, cross-org technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of hands-on engineering experience
Insufficient evidence of Principal-level scope and data/metrics aptitude
